name: Address Downtown Serviced Residences
tagline: Studio to 4-bedroom serviced residences in the Address Downtown tower, next to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall.
description:
Address Downtown publishes studio, 1, 2, 3 and 4 bedroom serviced residences in the same building as the hotel, ideal for long stays, with hotel services and access to on-site amenities.

Official address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashed Boulevard, Downtown Dubai, PO Box 123234, Dubai, UAE. Direct connection to Dubai Mall; steps from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain. Approximately 15–20 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

On-site amenities stated on the official page: four swimming pools (bubble pool, sun pool, children and family pool, and an adult infinity pool with Burj Khalifa views); Pool & Fitness recreation; The Spa with traditional Hammam, Finnish sauna and steam room, plus The Spa Longevity; Qix Club on Level 7 for ages 4–12; Club Lounge on Level 7 for Club Suites guests; seven restaurants (Cetara, Lounge, Café, The Garden, Cigar Lounge, GAL and KRASOTA Dubai); six meeting rooms. Pets are not accommodated. Check-in 15:00 / check-out 12:00. Room rates vary by stay dates; no standing tariff on the official page.

The hotel /residences/ path redirects to Address Marassi Golf Resort (Egypt) and was not used.
address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashed Boulevard, Downtown Dubai, PO Box 123234, Dubai, UAE

name: Address Beach Resort Residences
tagline: 435 beachfront serviced apartments at Address Beach Resort, JBR.
description:
Official residences page: 435 serviced apartments at Address Beach Resort. One-bedroom: 201 apartments, 59–107 sqm, maximum two adults, partial or full sea view or marina/city views, en-suite bathroom, furnished and fitted, fully-equipped open kitchen, one car parking space. Two-bedroom: 129 apartments, 110–187 sqm, maximum four guests, same view options, en-suite in every bedroom, furnished and fitted, one parking space. Three-bedroom: 99 apartments, 177–183 sqm, maximum six guests, optional sea and marina/city views (Type S3b sea view), two parking spaces. Four-bedroom: 9 apartments on levels 64–72, 291–338 sqm, maximum eight guests, sea views, two parking spaces. Five-bedroom: 466 sqm / 5,016 sqft, maximum ten guests, sea and marina/city views, two parking spaces.

Official resort address: Address Beach Resort, JBR, The Walk, Dubai. Two 77-storey towers with direct JBR beach access. Amenities stated on the resort page: four swimming pools including the Level 77 outdoor infinity pool (Guinness World Record, world’s highest outdoor infinity pool) and three ground-level pools (family and adult-only); state-of-the-art fitness centre; The Spa on the 75th floor (nine treatment rooms); The Qix Kids Club with outdoor splash pad. Residences are the extended-stay product on the same official site. No standing tariff on the official pages.
